text: Build job 7, part 2, of the records-history plan (docs/design/records-history.md section 13, decision D111): move every reader of records/ in the working tree to the athena/records branch. Depends on job 7 part 1 (the cutover) having landed. Keep a worktree of athena/records at a fixed path in Athena's state directory and point the readers there (Records::load, RecordSet::load, read_records, the walltime reader, status, forecasting, scoring, retry carry, audit, introspection, the study site generator). Acceptance: a test shows each reader returns the same result from the branch as from records/ at C0; athena status and a forecast work on a checkout with records/ removed from the working tree; cargo test passes.
